subject: knitr with the legacy markdown format

messages.author: 30b406a9189eeb25
messages.subject: knitr with the legacy markdown format
parts:
Hi,

I have a bunch of knit scripts written in markdown using the old html chunk definitions (<!--begin.rcode) 
I cannot seem to get these to render github flavored mardown output correctly any more with the github copy of knitr.
I call render_gfm() but I still get html-markup inside github code blocks ```r. 

I like the new style of markdown syntax, and the automatically detected rendering by using the extensions .Rmd and .Rhtml, but it's troubling that scripts that used to run and render correctly no longer do so.  What's the simplest way to run these old scripts?

Carl

--
Carl Boettiger
UC Davis
http://www.carlboettiger.info/

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] knitr with the legacy markdown format
parts:
Sorry for the troubles; render_gfm() is deprecated now; you should
call render_markdown() -- hopefully that is the only change you need
to make, if you use the latest version on Github.

See https://github.com/yihui/knitr/blob/master/NEWS for a list of
recent changes.

Regards,
Yihui
